targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value, result_id FROM le_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND value_present = true ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sample count, missing values and mean per run and action (SYNTHETIC)

targets.rawSql: SELECT result_id, application_id, metric_id, count(*) AS points, sum(CASE WHEN value_present THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS missing_values, min(time) AS first_observation, max(time) AS last_observation, avg(value) AS mean_ms FROM le_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY result_id, application_id, metric_id ORDER BY application_id, result_id
